note: Unofficial English translation for display. Not sealed: the sealed original of each event is the French text in case.json.

case.title: Karim B. v. Horizon Logistique SAS
case.court: Paris employment tribunal (conseil de prud'hommes), Commerce section
case.fictional: Every person, company, document and log in this case is fictional.

E1.title: AI performance score computed (PerfScore v2)
E1.text: Automated performance evaluation of Mr Karim B., order picker, by the PerfScore v2 system: score of 41 out of 100, alert threshold 50. Main factors: picking rate 18% below target over 3 months, picking errors reported.

E2.title: Report of the human review of the score
E2.text: The warehouse manager reviewed the score of 41 out of 100 during an evaluation meeting. The manager notes 6 picking errors over the quarter and proposes starting a procedure for professional inadequacy.

E3.title: Internal HR note
E3.text: Check the length of service and the statutory severance calculation before sending the notice of the pre-dismissal meeting.

E4.title: Notice of the pre-dismissal meeting
E4.text: Registered letter with acknowledgment of receipt inviting Mr Karim B. to a meeting prior to a possible dismissal, on 18 June 2026 at 14:00, at the company's head office.

E5.title: Pre-dismissal meeting held
E5.text: Pre-dismissal meeting held on 18 June 2026 in the presence of Mr Karim B., assisted by an employee adviser. Reason given by the employer: professional inadequacy.

E6.title: Dismissal letter
E6.text: Letter of dismissal for professional inadequacy, sent by registered mail with acknowledgment of receipt. Reason: insufficient results measured by the automated evaluation of 2 June 2026 and confirmed by the review of 5 June 2026. Notice period of 2 months.

E7.title: Dismissal letter received
E7.text: Acknowledgment of receipt of the dismissal letter, signed by Mr Karim B. on 27 June 2026.

E8.title: Application filed with the Paris employment tribunal
E8.text: Application by Mr Karim B. contesting his dismissal. Claims: damages for dismissal without genuine and serious cause; disclosure of the documentation and logs of the PerfScore v2 system used for the evaluation. 14 documents attached.

E9.title: Summons before the conciliation and orientation panel
E9.text: The registry of the Paris employment tribunal summons the parties before the conciliation and orientation panel on 5 November 2026 at 9:30, Commerce section. The parties are invited to exchange their documents before the hearing.

E10.title: Deadline set: send the documents to the employer
E10.text: Send the list and the 14 documents to the employer's lawyer by 29 October 2026, one week before the conciliation hearing.
E10.label: Send the 14 documents to the employer

E11.title: Deadline set: hand over the employer's documents
E11.text: Hand over to the company's lawyer the PerfScore v2 documentation and logs requested in the application, by 28 October 2026.
E11.label: Hand over the PerfScore v2 documentation to the lawyer
